_comment: UC1 P2-b window-evaluator config (design spec §3). All lane-closure revenue/delay/safety math is driven from here — nothing scoring-related is hardcoded in windowEval.js. tollRateUsd/weights are the 'missing numbers seeded in config, surfaced as editable assumptions' from spec Decision 4; sliders in the trust panel (P5) mutate a clone of this object at runtime.

scoreNormalization._comment: Reference scales that turn R(w)/delay/E(w)/crew into comparable ~0-1ish magnitudes before the weighted sum. Tunable, not load-bearing for ranking correctness (weights dominate rank order).

crashExposure._comment: normalizerVeh: 'typical' vehicle exposure a closure window sees, used to scale the blended incident rate into an index. segmentBlendK: shrinkage constant (spec §3 rate blend) — segment weight = n/(n+k), so a segment with 0 sample rows falls back to the corridor-wide rate exactly, and weight grows toward 1 as segment sample size n grows relative to k.

candidateHeuristics._comment: The 3 system-suggested windows (spec §3): next weeknight overnight, next weekend morning, next weekday 14:00 (the teaching-bad option — daytime closure during travel hours).

playback._comment: UC1 deck-parity item 1 (per-window SUMO playback). watchMsPerWindow: how long buildSumoPlaybackPlan()'s live-SUMO 'watch' step dwells per window before opening the lane again (Phase 2). surrogateTotalMs (Phase 3): offline/no-live-server animation duration for the analytic timeseries replay, read by windowPlayback.js's surrogatePlaybackDurationMs().

plannerPick._comment: UC1 deck-parity item 2 (planner window picker). Merged bounds block (plan conflict resolution #4) read by both validateWindowPick() (windowAssembly.js) and windowPicker.js's clampPlannerWindow(). minLeadHours: how far in the future a typed start must be.
